title: cd4027
description: `cd4027` emulates one half of a CMOS J/K flip-flop, producing Q and /Q outputs. A 0-to-1 transition or bang clocks it: J changes Q on the next clock when Q is 0, while K changes Q on the next clock when Q is 1; SET forces Q to 1 and RESET forces Q to 0, overriding the clock.
